item.title: Br-tailored local polarity of Zn single-atom catalyst for shuttle-free Zn-I2 batteries with fast iodine redox kinetics
item.description:
کاتالیزور تک‌اتمی Zn با تنظیم Br، قطبیت موضعی را برای باتری‌های Zn-I2 بدون شاتل با سینتیک سریع ید تنظیم می‌کند.
Energy & Environmental Science | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Br-tailored Zn single-atom catalysts create locally polarized Zn sites that accelerate iodine redox kinetics and suppress polyiodide shuttling in aqueous Zn-I2 batteries. This dual function enables shuttle-free operation with high rate capability and durable cycling, offering a rational design strategy for high-performance iodine-based energy storage.
🏷 Zn-I2 battery · single-atom catalyst · polyiodide shuttling · iodine redox kinetics · Br tailoring
